description:
We are a team of six motivated and ambitious students who are passionate about science, technology, innovation, and problem-solving. Our team brings together different interests, ideas, and abilities. We believe that teamwork, creativity, and knowledge are the keys to developing meaningful solutions to real-world challenges.

Our main interests include cybersecurity, information technology, programming, scientific research, data analysis, and space exploration.
summary: EarthTrend is a project focused on identifying and understanding changes in Earth's environment over time. It aims to analyze environmental data, detect trends, and visualize changes in different regions. By using NASA Earth science data, the project helps people understand environmental changes and their potential impact on our planet. Our goal is to make complex scientific information easier to explore and understand.
details:
EarthTrend is a project designed to help people understand changes in Earth's environmental system over time.

The project focuses on identifying environmental trends, comparing changes in different regions, and making scientific information easier to understand through visual presentation.

EarthTrend aims to help users explore important environmental indicators, such as temperature, climate patterns, water levels, and other Earth system variables. It focuses on understanding what is changing, where changes are happening, and how significant these changes may be.

The main benefit of this project is making complex Earth science information more accessible and understandable. It can support environmental awareness and help people better understand our changing planet.

The project was developed as a digital prototype using Claude AI Artifact technology. Artificial intelligence was used as an assistance tool during the development process.
